accessNotes: The public homepage and first-party search result captured on 2026-08-11 confirm LucidPro base prices of $135 / $185 / $285 / $370 and show separate temporary coupon prices; only the base prices are stored. The interactive JavaScript checkout was unavailable, so LucidFlex, LucidDirect and all four LucidDaily configurations remain unpriced. Lucid's current help center still defines four LucidDaily checkout configurations, while the current homepage product selector exposes Pro, Flex and Direct but not Daily and also renders legacy Black cards. This official-source lineup conflict remains unresolved. LucidBlack stays excluded because the help center labels it Legacy; LucidMaxx stays excluded because it is exclusive rather than a public challenge. The Allowed Trading Times article explicitly names Pro, Flex and Direct but not Daily, so LucidDaily weekend and overnight fields are null rather than inherited. Lucid's general Other Activities page describes Daily red-folder news broadly, while the product-specific funded page narrows the hard-breach window to events that are both U.S. high-impact and USD; the capture follows the product-specific page and retains news=restricted.

notes: BASE PRICES ONLY: $135 / $185 / $285 / $370 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. The live first-party result also showed temporary coupon prices of $94.50 / $129.50 / $199.50 / $259.00; those are not stored as durable prices.
TIER-SPECIFIC TARGETS: $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 equal 5% / 6% / 6% / 6%, so profitTargets stays null.
EOD TRAILING MLL: $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500; the line locks at starting balance plus $100 after the trail threshold.
DLL: none on $25K; $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 on $50K / $100K / $150K. It is a soft session stop unless MLL is reached.
PAYOUT: 90% trader split, 40% payout-cycle consistency, $500 request minimum, tier profit goals of $250 / $500 / $750 / $1,000, buffer equal to initial MLL plus $100, and no fixed request window.
TRADING TIMES: positions auto-close by 4:45 PM ET Monday-Friday and reopen 6:00 PM ET Sunday-Thursday; overnight and weekend holding are therefore false.
GENERAL RULES: news and automated systems are allowed. Trade copiers are allowed, but coordinated strategies, third-party trading and pooled risk are prohibited, so copyTrading is restricted.
REFUNDS: after trading begins, Lucid says paid fees are not refundable; unused-account exceptions are discretionary rather than guaranteed.
